items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights are live
items.oneliner: Open multimodal model with 1M context and downloadable weights for local serving, evals, and agent experiments today.

items.title: Codemap visualizes any Go repository
items.oneliner: Generate a single HTML map of packages, functions, and dependencies to understand unfamiliar Go codebases in minutes.

items.title: Go ships a safer JSON API
items.oneliner: New encoding/json/v2 fixes long-standing edge cases and gives Go teams stricter, more customizable JSON handling.

items.title: Benchstat workflow comes to Rust
items.oneliner: This Rust benchmarking toolkit brings Go-style benchstat comparisons, heap tracking, and profiling to microbenchmark-heavy code.

items.title: PostgreSQL internals guide stays unmatched
items.oneliner: Deep, practical reference for query execution, MVCC, WAL, and replication when Postgres behavior stops matching intuition.

items.title: This Postgres TOAST deep dive matters
items.oneliner: Concrete walkthrough of how oversized columns hurt performance, with lessons for debugging slow reads and writes.

items.title: Electronic voting cryptography explained clearly
items.oneliner: Useful security walkthrough of Helios, ElectionGuard, and why cryptography still does not replace paper ballots.

items.title: A real DNS hijacking investigation
items.oneliner: Hands-on writeup showing how to detect ISP DNS tampering and harden your setup with secure resolvers or VPNs.

items.title: Rust compiler speedups are dissected
items.oneliner: Detailed optimization notes show how span compression and caching delivered measurable compiler wins, especially in incremental builds.

items.title: Debian APT security fix is urgent
items.oneliner: Security advisory with actionable upgrade guidance for a man-in-the-middle APT flaw that could lead to root code execution.
